piezas.titulo: Production practice: Tone, politeness and implicit meaning
texto: Integrated conversation: taking part in a symposium on intercultural linguistics and communicative diplomacy. At Distinguished level you are assessed on your mastery of subtext, on using courteous softening appropriate to the interlocutor's status, and on explaining with complete conceptual precision how the culture of «เกรงใจ» permeates institutional negotiations. Use cultivated phrases such as «การรักษาน้ำใจ» (preserving emotional harmony) and «การสื่อความหมายโดยนัย» (communication by way of implicature).
